text: Rosstat classifies AO 'Obl-TV' — the company behind Chelyabinsk's OTV channel — as 'property of subjects of the Russian Federation' (owned by a region).

source.name: Checko — AO 'OBL-TV' (EGRUL/Rosstat codes)
source.note: Russian; Rosstat ownership-form code OKFS 13 'Property of subjects of the Russian Federation'. The same page: the company was created on 4 May 2018 'by reorganisation (transformation)' of the state enterprise of Chelyabinsk Oblast 'Oblastnoye Televideniye'. Page shows no publication date; Checko footer 2019-2026.
